description: These statistics describe the activity and crowding of Bermuda's public hospital system, run by the Bermuda Hospitals Board. The statistics page holds annual tables by financial year, from April 2021 to March 2025 when read, giving beds, patient days, discharges, length of stay, births and occupancy for the general wing, the acute care wing and the long-term care units of King Edward VII Memorial Hospital; the acute care wing ran at 96% to 99% occupancy throughout. Monthly performance snapshots, published as PDFs, give one row per day with emergency department visits, median minutes from arrival to triage, to being seen by a doctor and to departure, the wait from an admission decision to leaving the department, admissions, outpatient visits and surgical cases. All of it is free and available to read or download from the board's website. Caveats: the tables are web pages and PDFs, not data files, only recent months of snapshots are linked, no licence is stated, and coverage is limited to one island health system. Simulation uses: calibrating emergency department and bed-occupancy models for a small island hospital, and testing surge capacity during hurricanes or outbreaks.
